messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] api-redwood-prod: elevated 5xx rate > 7% (threshold 1.0%) — paging on-call @maya_k · incident id 2027-03-17-003 (auto-created)

maya_k: looking. seeing 503 spikes across frontend -> inference gateway. latency up ~40ms p95, error rate concentrated on /v1/generate. no deploys in last 6h.

jordan_i: on it — checking autoscale and GPU pool health. any sign of gpu OOMs or node drains?

maya_k: n2gpu nodes healthy. logs show repeated upstream timeout to model-backend-03 with socket errors. suspect hot shard on model-backend-03.

maya_k: quick mitigation: divert 25% of traffic off model-backend-03 and increase pool size by 2 replicas. doing manual traffic shift now.

maya_k: ```
# divert 25% away from model-backend-03
redwoodctl traffic shift --service inference-gateway --from-host model-backend-03 --percent 25
# scale pool
redwoodctl scale --pool model-backend --replicas +2
```

jordan_i: executed scale +2, warming new replicas. verifying KV cache warmup. will also rotate one worker on model-backend-03.

sam_ops: any customer impact yet? need to notify CS if > 5% of requests affected.

maya_k: early estimate: ~12% of requests got 503s during spike window (17:02-17:12 UTC). sticky sessions caused a handful of enterprise customers to see degraded responses. rough count: ~40 distinct API keys with > 5 failed calls. tagging @emily_pm for customer comms.

emily_pm: thanks — will draft a notice if confirmed after postmortem. please capture list of affected API keys.

raj_sre: adding note — model-backend-03 shows recurrent slow event loop at high concurrency; garbage collection spikes correlate with timeout windows. collecting heap profiles.

maya_k: okay remedial steps done. traffic split in place and pool scaled. error rate trending down to 0.9% now. keeping watch for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident 2027-03-17-003 status: mitigation in place · severity: Sev2 · current error rate 0.9% · uptime impact: partial degraded for subset of requests.

maya_k: small handoff in 25m — I need to hand off to next on-call. planning to leave follow-ups in this thread.

sam_ops: noted. @ashley_s on next rotation? can we do a live short handoff doc?

ashley_s: available — will join in 20m for handoff and takeover.

maya_k: handoff checklist (brief):
- what happened: hot shard / model-backend-03 GC spikes -> timeouts
- mitigation performed: traffic shift 25% + scale + rotate worker
- state: error rate back to baseline, replicas warmed, KV cache warming ongoing
- immediate follow-ups: collect heap profiles, export logs for 17:00-17:15 window, extract affected API keys, schedule postmortem.

maya_k: transferring ownership to @ashley_s now. leaving notes in ops doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/2027-03-17-003 (will update with artifacts).

ashley_s: got it — taking over. thanks @maya_k. I'll monitor for the next 2h and confirm close after 60m stable. :thumbsup:

raj_sre: quick ask — preserve core dumps/heap dumps from model-backend-03 instance-id i-0a1b2c3d. otherwise data gone on recycle.

jordan_i: saved dumps to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/2027-03-17-003/ and flagged retention.

ashley_s: status update after 45m: error rate stable at 0.7%, no new spikes. starting to collect artifacts for postmortem. planning a 60-min postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC; @emily_pm can you confirm?

emily_pm: 10:00 UTC works for me. booking 60m and inviting engineering, infra, SRE, and CS leads. calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood/meet/pm/2027-03-18-10-00 (I'll add agenda).

maya_k: adding suggested agenda: timeline reconstruction, root cause evidence (GC + concurrency), mitigation timeline, customer impact, action item creation + sizing, owners + priorities.

ashley_s: creating action items now in-thread so we have initial owners and rough sizes. will convert to tickets after the meeting.

ashley_s: AI-101: Root cause deep-dive (collect heap profiles, reproduce locally, GC analysis) — owner: @raj_sre — size: 1d (investigation) + 2d fix estimate (if code change needed) — priority: P0 (severity-driven) — tags: SRE-Q2-reliability

ashley_s: AI-102: Auto-traffic-split rule for hot-backend protection (policy: auto-shift 20% when backend latency > 250ms for 3 min) — owner: @jordan_i — size: 3d dev + 2d rollout and testing — priority: P1 — tags: infra-safety, Q2-ops

ashley_s: AI-103: Short-term runbook update (include checklist: preserve dumps, traffic shift commands, handoff checklist) — owner: @maya_k — size: 4h — priority: P1 — tags: runbooks, oncall-ease

ashley_s: AI-104: Customer-impact extraction + comms draft (list API keys, impact timing, CS message) — owner: @emily_pm — size: 4h — priority: P1 — tags: customer-ops

ashley_s: AI-105: Observability: add GC metrics to per-backend dashboard, add alert for sustained >200ms tail latencies — owner: @raj_sre with @ops (collab) — size: 4d — priority: P2 — tags: observability, Q2-product

sam_ops: can we map these into quarterly priorities? need to flag AI-101 & AI-102 as part of Q2 Reliability epic — will add to planning doc.

emily_pm: agreed — P0/P1 items go into next sprint planning. P2 into backlog but tagged Q2 observability work.

maya_k: rough ordering by impact/time:
1) AI-101 (P0) — unblock customer regressions
2) AI-102 (P1) — prevents repeated mitigation overhead
3) AI-104 (P1) — customer-facing comms
4) AI-103 (P1 small) — helps oncall efficiency
5) AI-105 (P2) — longer-term visibility

ashley_s: adding tentative due dates: AI-101 due 2027-03-24, AI-102 due 2027-04-04, AI-104 draft by 2027-03-18, AI-103 by 2027-03-20, AI-105 by 2027-04-15. will create tickets and link to postmortem doc.

raj_sre: +1 on dates. I'll start on profiling and share artifacts in the postmortem doc.

jordan_i: blocking note for AI-102: need an RBAC exception for redwoodctl traffic ops to be scheduled with eng-security. will raise IFR ticket.

emily_pm: I'll coordinate CS comms after AI-104 lands. we should avoid sending until root cause is clear but acknowledge customers with the current mitigation note.

ashley_s: closing loop: monitoring for 2h more; if stable at T+2h I'll mark incident resolved and convert AIs into tickets in Jira with tags above. thanks team. :pray:

incident-bot: Incident 2027-03-17-003 mitigation: stable · updating status to monitoring · incident owner: ashley_s

ashley_s: incident resolved at 18:40 UTC — will post final incident note and link to postmortem when ready.

emily_pm: thanks all. meeting invite is up. please add any prep items to the doc and assign follow-ups during the postmortem.

maya_k: great work everyone. tagging for visibility: @eng-leads, @sre, @customer-support.

(reacted with :eyes: by emily_pm, :thumbsup: by jordan_i)
